race.comment: LAGUNANINI (12) has to answer for a plain last at Kilmore, but she was still respected there, draws barrier 1 and brings strong ratings from last campaign. Looks the one to side with in this. ETERNAL DARKNESS (5) resumes from five months off with two trial wins since last racing, including a Seymour trial win two weeks ago, so he can improve sharply on the form that ended last campaign. CUMBOOGLE (4) could give a sight. Continues to turn up and do so. TIME ANGEL (8) comes here following a win over 1100m at Berrigan three weeks ago, getting home by 0.8 lengths. Profiles to run well.
